en: Black-and-white image showing an older woman working at a service counter, possibly at a post or telephone office. She is placing or operating a device on the counter in front of her, with several ink stamps nearby. Behind a glass partition is a sign overhead. Reflections of other people can be seen through the glass, suggesting a public-service interior rather than a scenic outdoor view.
